displayName: Active Directory NTDS.dit Extraction via Ntdsutil IFM

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "ac i ntds", "activate instance ntds")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Active Directory NTDS.dit Extraction via Ntdsutil IFM
alertTemplate.description: Detects ntdsutil.exe invoked with Install From Media (IFM) arguments to dump the Active Directory NTDS.dit database, a living off the land credential theft technique highlighted in ASD/ACSC guidance. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Verify whether an authorised domain controller backup or IFM promotion is underway; if unauthorised, isolate the host and reset KRBTGT and privileged credentials immediately (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657; Advisories: acsc-2024-02-07-identifying-and-mitigating-living-off-the-land-techniques, acsc-2026-10-09-chinese-state-linked-automated-tools).
